newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB to strengthen marketing thrust.
newsitem.headline: PNB to strengthen marketing thrust.

text.p: Philippine National Bank (PNB) is refocusing its operations from to July to turn half its workforce into marketing specialists, PNB officials said on Thursday.
Senior vice president Liwayway Gener said the programme will not entail substantial costs since it would mainly involve reorientation of its more than 7,000 employees.
Competition in the local banking industry has heightened in the past years following the entry of foreign banks as well as new local banks.
Instead of spending most of their time processing, the bank's branches will focus more on sales and services.
"We expect 40 to 50 percent reduction in the headcount of the branch personnel structure," she said. The bank has more than 300 branches nationwide.
Ana Candelaria, an investment analyst of Eastern Securities, said the move will finally put PNB in equal footing as other commercial banks which have put a premium on customer service.
PNB, which used to be a government-controlled bank, had relied on government deposits to support its revenue stream.
